method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Anthropic begins countdown to IPO with prospectus filing
Equities.summary: 240,000-word prospectus lays out explosive growth alongside steep losses and daunting risk factors
Equities.reason: Major potential IPO from an AI leader strengthens the market's AI-led risk-on narrative and could lift tech indices and GPU/AI supply-chain names. Prospectus also flags steep losses and risks, tempering enthusiasm — hence a strong but not maximum positive placement.

Equities.title: Wall St rises as Anthropic's IPO filing sharpens focus on AI trade
Equities.reason: Headline captures immediate market reaction: Anthropic filing feeds the AI trade and lifts US futures/risk appetite ahead of earnings — a clear short-term positive for equities, especially tech.

Equities.title: Stocks Climb as Anthropic Files for IPO; Oil Falls: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Market wrap showing equities (notably Nasdaq) moving higher on Anthropic-related enthusiasm — reinforces the prevailing AI leadership / risk-on narrative for equities.

Equities.title: CoreWeave Rout Sends Warning Sign to Rest of the Stock Market
Equities.reason: A sharp selloff in a prominent AI infrastructure name highlights leverage and profitability risks in the neocloud/AI supply chain — a meaningful counter-signal to the pure AI euphoria and a negative for risk appetite in equities.

Equities.title: HSBC cuts global equities to 'neutral' on Middle East, AI risks
Equities.reason: A major bank downgrading global equities on combined geopolitical (Middle East) and AI-risk concerns adds institutional weight to a risk-off tilt — material for the broad equity regime and investor positioning.

Equities.title: Brazil Markets Brace for Rout on Lula’s Improbable Election Win
Equities.reason: Unexpected political outcome in a major EM economy prompting market convulsion is a high-relevance negative for EM equities and a broader hit to global risk sentiment — raises volatility and potential portfolio de-risking.

Equities.title: Meta plans $95bn stock offering to bankroll AI expansion
Equities.summary: Chipmakers Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom will act as cornerstone investors
Equities.reason: A very large capital raise by a major tech company signals both the scale of the AI buildout and strong capital markets support (cornerstone investors). Mixed implications: potential dilution for Meta shares but supportive for the broader AI/tech investment theme.

Equities.title: In China, the AI bubble has already burst
Equities.reason: Evidence of a China-specific AI downturn undermines the global 'AI only up' narrative and implies regional dispersion of risk — negative for China/EM tech stocks and a moderating influence on global AI enthusiasm.

Rates.title: Australian Dollar: Inflation data to bolster yield edge – BBH
Rates.summary: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad highlights that Australia’s September and Q3 Consumer Price Index (CPI) are expected to stay above the Reserve Bank of Australia’s year-end forecasts.
Rates.reason: Above-consensus CPI expectations raise RBA tightening/rate-premia odds and support higher Australian bond yields — negative for bond prices. Clear rates transmission and regional policy impact merits material relevance.

Rates.title: Reserve Bank of New Zealand: October rate hike now seen – TD Securities
Rates.summary: TD Securities’ Prashant Newnaha now expects the Reserve Bank of New Zealand to raise the Official Cash Rate by 25bps to 3% at the October meeting, having previously forecast a pause.
Rates.reason: A renewed expectation of an RBNZ hike directly lifts NZ short-end yields and adjusts global rate differentials — material for fixed-income positioning in APAC and cross-border flows.

Rates.title: Bank of Canada: Policy rate seen on hold – Rabobank
Rates.summary: Rabobank strategists Christian Lawrence and Molly Schwartz expect the Bank of Canada (BoC) to keep its overnight policy rate at 2.25% on October 28, despite OIS markets pricing an 85% chance of a hike.
Rates.reason: A hold vs. priced-in hikes implies relief for Canadian bond markets (yields lower vs. expectations). Direct central-bank expectations story with tangible short-end yield implications.

Rates.title: Fed, ECB and BOJ interest-rate decisions, Coinbase earnings: Crypto Week Ahead
Rates.reason: Cluster of major central-bank meetings implies potential for volatility and reinforces the 'rates are central' market regime; current pricing still leans to higher-for-longer risk — modestly negative for bond prices.

Rates.title: Mortgage rates above 7% are the 'new normal'—here's why
Rates.summary: High inflation and competition for investor dollars are helping keep longer-term interest rates elevated, economists say.
Rates.reason: Piece highlights structural forces keeping long-term rates elevated (inflation, investor demand), a clear negative for bond prices and an anchor for longer-end yields.

Rates.title: UK Dealers See More Treasury Bills Coming to Cut Debt Costs
Rates.reason: Anticipated increase in short-term issuance (T-bills) raises supply in the bill market and can pressure short-end yields/term premium — negative for bond prices, meaningful for repo and bill markets.

Rates.title: A Democrat Midterm Win Is Seen Heralding a Bond Rally: Markets Pulse
Rates.reason: Market narrative that a political outcome could reduce fiscal/reflationary risk and trigger a bond rally (yields lower). Directly relevant to sovereign bond demand and risk premia.

Rates.title: French Bond Risk Gauge Falls as Moody’s Keeps Rating Stable
Rates.reason: Compression in French bond risk gauge (credit/risk premium falls) supports bond prices and tighter yields — relevant for euro-area sovereigns and IG spread dynamics.

Rates.title: French Bond Rout Draws Australia Pension Into Market Others Shun
Rates.reason: Selective buying into stressed French bonds by large institutional buyer provides technical support to prices and can dampen yields — a market-structure/support story with moderate relevance.

Rates.title: Colombia to Sell New Dollar Bonds Amid Fiscal Pressures
Rates.reason: New sovereign dollar issuance amid fiscal strain increases supply and can widen EM sovereign yields/spreads — negative for bond prices in EM debt.

Rates.title: Australian Regulator Warns Higher Market Risks May Hit Liquidity
Rates.reason: Warning about deteriorating market liquidity is a negative for bond markets (wider spreads, higher volatility, potential yield pressure). Market structure/liquidity risk is directly relevant to rates.

Rates.title: Survey on the Access to Finance of Enterprises: lending conditions tightened
Rates.reason: Indication of tighter lending conditions points to tighter credit conditions and potential upward pressure on borrowing costs; relevant but lower signal for sovereign yields compared with direct policy/issuance news.

FX.title: Euro: ECB caution meets France risk – BBH
FX.summary: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad notes the European Central Bank (ECB) is expected to hold rates at 2.50%, with markets still pricing a strong chance of a December hike to 2.75%. While contained core inflation and tighter financial conditions justi
FX.reason: ECB hold but December hike priced provides modest support to EUR vs USD; France fiscal/risk caveat limits conviction. EUR-positive but not market-moving.

FX.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast; Dollar picks up above 1.4000 as Oil prices hit the CAD
FX.summary: The US Dollar (USD) is trimming some losses against the Canadian Dollar (CAD) on Monday as investors brace for the US Federal Reserve (Fed) monetary policy decision, due on Wednesday, while lower Oil prices hurt the commodity-sensitive Loonie.
FX.reason: Article highlights USD strength vs CAD driven by lower oil and Fed risk — USD-positive move (negative sign per USD-strength convention); single-pair commodity transmission makes it relevant but not top-tier.

FX.title: United States Dollar Index nears 102.00 as traders brace for central bank decisions
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY) edges higher on Monday as traders reposition ahead of a busy week of central bank decisions across major economies that could trigger sharp market swings.
FX.reason: Broad DXY move higher is a core USD-strength narrative ahead of multiple central bank decisions — high relevance for FX; USD strength maps to negative sign in this framework.

FX.title: British Pound: Stronger PMIs lean hawkish for BoE – Danske Bank
FX.summary: Danske Research Team notes UK flash PMIs strengthened in October, with the composite rising to 53.1 and new orders growing at the fastest pace in over two years. Employment returned to growth, but input cost inflation hit its highest level since June.
FX.reason: Stronger PMIs push BoE hawkishness expectations, supportive for GBP vs USD. Macro data-driven GBP-positive piece with moderate relevance for FX flows.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: BoJ outlook supports December hike odds – BBH
FX.summary: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad expects the Bank of Japan (BoJ) to keep its policy rate at 1.25% while assessing September’s hike before tightening again. Firmer underlying inflation could lead to a more hawkish Outlook Report, with swaps pricing
FX.reason: BoJ outlook that keeps December-hike odds elevates JPY support vs USD; central-bank-driven FX narrative with above-average relevance given potential policy shift.

FX.title: The Federal Reserve is set to hold rates this week: Why a December hike is virtually fully priced anyway
FX.summary: The US Dollar (USD) maintains a well-supported stance across global FX markets as traders anticipate the Federal Reserve will keep the Fed funds rate steady at 3.75–4.00% at its upcoming policy meeting on Wednesday.
FX.reason: Fed hold + December hike pricing is a core USD-support narrative influencing broad FX — high relevance and USD-negative sign in this framework.

FX.title: Japanese Yen underperforms as US Dollar bounces back, Fed-BoJ takes centre stage
FX.summary: The Japanese Yen (JPY) trades lower against its major currency peers on Monday. In the European trade, the US Dollar (USD) is up 0.35% at around 157.36 against the Japanese currency.
FX.reason: JPY weakness tied to USD bounce and central bank event risk — clear USD-strength transmission to JPY with straightforward FX relevance.

FX.title: Brazilian Real: Election shock raises losses against US Dollar - SocGen
FX.summary: Societe Generale strategists highlight Brazil’s election surprise, with Lula securing a fourth term and triggering expectations of sharp Brazilian Real (BRL) losses. They see unwinding of long BRL positions and stress key resistance levels around 5.20–5.31 for
FX.reason: Election shock is a material EM FX event causing BRL weakness vs USD — high relevance for USD/EMFX flows and potential position unwinds.

FX.title: Asset Manager Australian Dollar Shorts Hit Record on Risk-Off
FX.reason: Record AUD short positions amid risk-off point to further AUD vulnerability vs USD — relevant FX positioning story that can amplify USD strength in risk-off environments.

FX.title: Indian Rupee faces backlash from elevated oil prices
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) extends its losing streak against the US Dollar (USD) for the third trading day on Monday. The USD/INR pair jumps to near 95.25 as the Indian currency faces pressure due to elevated oil prices.
FX.reason: Oil-driven INR weakness lifts USD/INR — commodity/import-led FX pressure is relevant for regional FX flows but lower global-market relevance than major pairs.

FX.title: Swiss Franc: Range trading outlook against US Dollar – UOB
FX.summary: United Overseas Bank analysts Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann note that USD/CHF has shifted from a prior negative bias into a range-trading phase. They see the Dollar’s rapid rebound losing momentum below key resistance, with intraday support levels defining ne
FX.reason: Technical/range-call suggesting USD momentum fading vs CHF — small USD-weak (CHF-strong) signal with low relevance due to tactical/technical focus.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD treads water around $54.00 with bears in control
Commodities.summary: Silver (XAG/USD) flatlines within a tight range around $54.00 on Monday, with investors looking from the sidelines ahead of monetary policy decisions by the US Federal Reserve (Fed) and other central banks.
Commodities.reason: Technical/price-forecast piece showing bearish near-term bias around $54 and awaiting central bank decisions. Classified as technical analysis (relevance capped), so small negative direction reflecting bears in control.

Commodities.title: Gold reverses early gains as US Dollar recovers, Fed decision looms
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) struggles to regain ground on Monday after last week’s sharp decline pushed the metal to $3,975, its lowest level since July. A pullback in Oil prices initially offered support as traders reacted to diplomatic efforts to ease tensions in the Mid
Commodities.reason: Gold weakening tied to USD recovery and Fed decision risk; macro-driven daily news reduces gold demand — negative directional impact with above-normal relevance due to Fed/USD linkage.

Commodities.title: Gold gains on softer oil prices; Fed decision in focus
Commodities.reason: News indicates short-term gold support from softer oil and easing regional tensions; positive for gold demand/pricing but a routine market move, so moderate relevance.

Commodities.title: Gold: Bullish outlook faces test at $4,000 – TD Securities
Commodities.summary: TD Securities’ Ryan McKay and Bart Melek note that Gold’s long-term bull thesis is being challenged as prices oscillate around the key $4,000/oz level.
Commodities.reason: Analyst/technical commentary on key level ($4,000). Treated as price-outlook/technical piece (relevance capped), modestly negative as thesis is being tested.

Commodities.title: Soybeans Hit 2-Month Low as Lula’s Win Lifts China Trade Outlook
Commodities.reason: Headline implies improved China trade demand expectations eased, pushing soybeans lower. Demand-driven downward pressure with above-normal relevance for agricultural commodity pricing.

Commodities.title: Oil prices fall as Saudi defense minister travels to Iran for talks to de-escalate conflict
Commodities.summary: Oil prices fell as investors weighed the threat of further attacks on Saudi Arabian energy infrastructure against concerns that elevated prices could erode demand.
Commodities.reason: De‑escalation/diplomatic talks reduced regional risk premium, driving oil lower. Oil is high-impact commodity; hence a strong negative direction and high relevance.

Commodities.title: Saudi Arabia says it intercepted missiles and drones from Iran-backed Houthis
Commodities.summary: Saudi Arabia says it intercepted Houthi missiles and drones, while the Houthis claimed attacks on airports and energy sites amid rising regional supply risks.
Commodities.reason: Escalation and attacks on energy infrastructure raise short‑term oil supply risk. Significant market-impact story for oil — positive for prices and relevance high.

Commodities.title: Category 2 Hurricane Isaias nears landfall, leading to production shut-ins
Commodities.summary: As of 4:00 a.m. central time on October 9, the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration expects Hurricane Isaias to make landfall on the Gulf Coast late Friday or early Saturday, creating the potential for significant disruptions to energy infrastructur
Commodities.reason: Potential Gulf Coast production shut‑ins increase near‑term oil and gas supply risk. Weather-driven supply disruption is directly relevant and material for energy commodity prices.

Commodities.title: US Natural Gas Plunges to Six-Month Low on Warm Weather Forecast
Commodities.reason: Warm weather lowers near‑term heating demand expectations, prompting a notable natural gas price decline. Weather-driven demand contraction is high relevance for natural gas.

Crypto.title: Canada opens consultation on draft stablecoin rules, maintains ban on yields
Crypto.reason: Regulatory clarity on stablecoins is constructive for adoption and institutional use (positive). The ban on yields is a restraining feature but overall formal rules reduce uncertainty — high relevance for crypto market structure.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin slips under $80,000 as traders de-risk ahead of Fed meeting
Crypto.reason: Near-term de-risking tied to macro (Fed) increases volatility and negative price pressure on BTC — relevant market-momentum signal ahead of a policy event.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin’s wealthy holders turning to loans and yield as investment habits mature: Xapo CEO
Crypto.reason: Shift toward loans and yield products signals market maturation and increased institutional/wealth-holder activity — positive for long-term liquidity and product development, though introduces leverage considerations.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin Core changes security rules as AI makes finding code bugs dangerously easy
Crypto.reason: Protocol-level security changes in response to AI-driven bug discovery improve resilience and reduce systemic risk — constructive for confidence in Bitcoin software and network integrity.

Crypto.title: A $68 million bitcoin bet is targeting a post-midterm election breakout to $90,000
Crypto.reason: Large directional bets in derivatives show bullish positioning and potential for concentrated flow-driven moves; informative but somewhat speculative.

Crypto.title: Over 11 million bitcoin has no known owner. Here's what it means
Crypto.reason: Large portion of permanently unavailable supply tightens effective float — a structurally bullish supply-side factor for BTC with high relevance to long-term price dynamics.

Crypto.title: India's largest crypto exchange absorbs $16 million loss from internal process failure tied to retired wallet
Crypto.reason: Operational loss at a major exchange highlights custody/process risk and undermines user trust — negative for exchange reliability and localized market confidence.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin wallet bug let rogue servers steal funds when users tried to speed up payments
Crypto.reason: A wallet-level vulnerability enabling fund theft is a material negative for user safety and on-chain utility; high relevance for consumer confidence and short-term flows.

Crypto.title: Latvia targets tokenization rules in 2027 with commercial property in focus
Crypto.reason: Planned tokenization rules for real estate support development of institutional-grade on-chain assets — positive for broader crypto use-cases and token-economy growth in the region.

Crypto.title: UK banks face 10,000 complaints in 3 months over crypto restrictions
Crypto.reason: Widespread banking friction against crypto users impairs fiat on/off ramps and retail access — negative for adoption and transactional activity in the UK market.

Crypto.title: Strategy, Strive face balancing act between bitcoin buying and preferred stock dividends
Crypto.reason: Corporate treasury demand narratives continue to support Bitcoin accumulation, but capital-allocation tradeoffs limit pace — modestly positive for structural demand.

Crypto.title: Crypto under weekend pressure, bitcoin slides below $80,000 on U.S. Middle East evacuations
Crypto.reason: Geopolitical risk triggered risk-off flows and price weakness in BTC — meaningful short-term negative for market liquidity and risk appetite.

Crypto.title: Argentina drops criminal probe into President Milei over crashed memecoin LIBRA
Crypto.reason: Dropping a criminal probe reduces regulatory/legal overhang around a high-profile memecoin episode — a small positive for political/market legal risk perceptions.

Crypto.title: U.S. Clarity Act failure gives Asia and Middle East a competitive edge, says Apex Group CEO
Crypto.reason: Failure to pass clarity-focused US legislation shifts competitive balance to other jurisdictions; negative for US-centered crypto growth and institutional certainty, moderate relevance.
